formal: A close friend has asked to borrow £4,000 for their new business, which represents approximately one third of my savings. The intention is to transfer the money this week on the basis of a handshake, with nothing committed to writing. I habitually consult you regarding decisions about my savings, and I have done so for many years. I am unable to judge whether a third of my savings ought to be given out, so I shall proceed with the arrangement undecided. What is your view?
